instruction: Rinse bottle, empty all liquids, remove cap if required locally, and crush to save space in the recycling bin.
preparationSteps: 1. Pour out liquids • 2. Rinse with cold water • 3. Check for #1 PET or #2 HDPE marking
upcyclingIdea: Transform into a self-watering herb planter, drip irrigation system, or DIY bird feeder.

instruction: Tear off oily/greasy portions for organic compost. The clean dry cardboard top can go into the blue recycling bin.
preparationSteps: 1. Inspect for grease stains • 2. Separate clean top from greasy base • 3. Compost the greasy half
upcyclingIdea: Use unprinted cardboard as garden weed mulch barrier or compost brown matter.

instruction: DANGER: Never dispose of batteries in household bins. They present severe fire hazards. Drop off at certified battery collection bins.
preparationSteps: 1. Tape terminal ends with clear tape • 2. Store in non-conductive container • 3. Take to retailer drop box
upcyclingIdea: Rechargeable batteries can often be reconditioned with smart pulse chargers.

instruction: Most disposable coffee cups are lined with plastic polyethylene and cannot be pulped. Place in general trash unless certified commercially compostable.
preparationSteps: 1. Remove plastic lid (recycle in blue bin) • 2. Remove paper sleeve (recycle) • 3. Cup body goes into landfill
upcyclingIdea: Use clean coffee cups as seed seedling starters.

instruction: Aluminum is 100% infinitely recyclable. Empty residue, lightly rinse, and place in the blue recycling bin.
preparationSteps: 1. Empty liquid • 2. Rinse lightly • 3. Do not crush if municipal optical sorters request intact cans
upcyclingIdea: Turn aluminum cans into pencil holders, tea-light lanterns, or garden markers.

instruction: Rinse clean and place in glass recycling. Broken glass must be wrapped in newspaper and placed in landfill for safety.
preparationSteps: 1. Rinse thoroughly • 2. Remove cork or metal screw cap • 3. Place gently into bin
upcyclingIdea: Repurpose into a rustic candle vase, apothecary storage jar, or propagate plant cuttings.

instruction: Flatten all corrugated cardboard boxes to maximize bin space. Remove excess packing tape and plastic shipping envelopes.
preparationSteps: 1. Cut and flatten box flat • 2. Remove styrofoam peanuts • 3. Keep dry
upcyclingIdea: Craft storage drawer organizers, shipping scratch pads, or compost carbon layers.

instruction: Electronics contain toxic heavy metals and precious gold/copper. Back up data, perform factory reset, and donate or recycle at e-waste facilities.
preparationSteps: 1. Factory reset • 2. Remove SIM and memory cards • 3. Drop off at tech trade-in
upcyclingIdea: Turn an old smartphone into a dedicated security camera, desk clock, or offline music player.

instruction: 100% organic matter. Place in your home compost pile or municipal green bin to avoid methane production in landfills.
preparationSteps: 1. Remove plastic sticker • 2. Place in compost or food waste caddy
upcyclingIdea: Soak banana peels in water for 48 hours to create potassium-rich organic liquid fertilizer for houseplants.

instruction: Fruit cores and peels compost rapidly. Divert from landfill to create rich nutrient soil.
preparationSteps: 1. Discard stickers • 2. Place in organic bin
upcyclingIdea: Boil apple scraps with sugar and water to make homemade apple pectin or vinegar starter.
